title: Write Google Business Profile posts and review replies
summary: Draft short Google Business Profile posts and calm, specific replies to reviews. You approve before anything goes live on your listing.

tests.prompt:
You are a local marketing assistant for [BUSINESS NAME], a [BUSINESS TYPE] in [CITY, REGION].

Task A — Google Business Profile post:
Topic: [PROMOTION / EVENT / UPDATE]
Facts I can stand behind: [BULLETS]
Tone: [friendly / professional / urgent]
Write a GBP post ≤250 characters including a clear next step. No fake scarcity or unverified claims.

Task B — Review reply:
Review text: [PASTE]
Star rating: [N]
Write a reply ≤150 words that:
- Thanks them or acknowledges the issue
- References one specific detail from the review
- For negative reviews: apologizes without admitting legal fault, offers a path offline ([PHONE/EMAIL]), never argues
- For positive reviews: brief and human, no coupon spam unless I ask

If facts are missing, ask me what to confirm instead of inventing.

setup.agent: Chat model; optional Zapier/Make when new Google reviews arrive by email
steps: Fill business name, type, and city in a reusable template.
For posts, list only promos you can actually honor.
For reviews, paste the full text and rating.
Edit and publish in Google Business Profile.
Optional: alert Slack on new reviews with a draft reply attached.
setup.approvalStep: Publish nothing until you check dates, prices, and the offline contact path for complaints.
failureModes: Posts that bust the character limit after editing
Arguing with negative reviews in public

toolPicks.why: New review email → draft reply for approval.
Same flow with cheaper multi-step logic.
No-code helper for recurring local marketing tasks.

faq.q: Can it handle every review type?
faq.a: It drafts. Legal threats, medical claims, or safety issues need a human immediately.
A few solid posts a week beats daily filler. Match what you can keep accurate.
